documents: Negative Covenant: the borrower shall not incur any additional indebtedness in excess of $500 million, except for permitted refinancings and intercompany loans in the ordinary course.
Financial Covenant: Consolidated Leverage Ratio shall not exceed 4.50x, measured at each fiscal quarter end; failure to comply constitutes an Event of Default.

| Covenant | Threshold |
|---|---|
| Leverage Ratio | 4.50x |
| Interest Coverage | 2.50x |
| Senior Secured Net Leverage | 3.25x |
Term Sheet: Acme Refinancing, $1.2B senior secured notes, maturity 2029, priced at SOFR + 350bps, callable at 101, subject to customary closing conditions.
Term Sheet - Amortization: 1.0% per annum from 2026, 2.0% per annum from 2028, balance due at maturity; no financial maintenance covenants on the notes.
Risk Factor: a substantial portion of our revenue depends on refinancing activity, which declines when credit conditions tighten and spreads widen.
Risk Factor: our momentum strategy is vulnerable to sharp reversals when crowded trades unwind; prior episodes of forced deleveraging caused concentrated drawdowns.
Equity Research: crowded momentum positions show elevated fragility; a semi-unwind pattern - clustered selling with weak absorption - historically precedes larger drawdowns.
